step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified user actor (UserConsumerWeb) accessing content served via CloudFront CDN.
2. Identified request flow through Lambda Origin Request to S3 origin bucket for security and SEO rewrites.
3. Identified response flow from S3 origin bucket through Lambda Origin Response back to CloudFront for header and cache handling.
4. Identified content publishing flow from Crownpeak SaaS multi-tenant CMS directly to S3 bucket.
5. Identified AI services used by Crownpeak CMS for metadata and analysis: Rekognition for visual asset metadata and alt tags, and Comprehend for sentiment analysis and entity extraction.
6. Mapped nodes and flows accurately following valid vocabulary lists and strict logical sequencing.

graph.name: Crownpeak Serverless CMS Content Delivery and Management Architecture
graph.notes: Crownpeak decouples content management from content delivery. The multi-tenant CMS uses AI services like Comprehend and Rekognition for asset metadata enrichment, and directly publishes static web content into single-tenant AWS delivery environments composed of CloudFront, Lambda functions for origin request/response processing, and S3 origin storage.

edges.notes: User requests web content from CloudFront CDN.
CloudFront invokes Origin Request Lambda function.
Origin Request Lambda routes request to S3 origin bucket.
S3 origin returns content payload to Origin Response Lambda.
Origin Response Lambda delivers processed response to CloudFront.
Crownpeak multi-tenant CMS directly publishes static web content into single-tenant S3 origin bucket.
CMS invokes Rekognition to generate image metadata and alt text.
CMS invokes Comprehend for text sentiment analysis and taxonomy tag extraction.
